arabic text: Mohammed ka gharaana, Karbala waale bayaan baa mei
english translation text: The Household of Muhammad lies upon the plains of Karbala,

arabic text: Qayaamat ki khiza, Aayi her Zahra ke gulistaan mei
english translation text: The season of calamity has descended upon every garden of Zahra.

arabic text:
Zameen e Karbala isko, zaraa aaraam sei rakhna
Sulaaya hai Ali Asgher ko shehne tere daaman mei
english translation text:
O land of Karbala, cradle him with the utmost care,
For within your embrace rests Ali Asghar asleep.

arabic text:
Laashe Aun o Muhammed aaka laaye jo ranse,
Zainab, ne uthaaye haath Shukre Ilaahi mei
english translation text:
When the master brought back the bodies of Aun and Muhammad from the battlefield,
Zainab raised her hands in gratitude before her Lord.

arabic text:
Kahaan ho tum Ali Akbar zaraa aawaaz toh dena
Akela, rehgaya hei Ali ka laal maidaan mei
english translation text:
Where are you, Ali Akbar? Give but a single reply,
The son of Ali stands alone upon the field.

arabic text:
Laashe Ali Akbar uthti hei nahin aaqa sei
Ya Ali, zara utth-ke Najaf sei aayi-o maidaan mei
english translation text:
The body of Ali Akbar can no longer be lifted by the master,
O Ali, arise from Najaf and come to the battlefield.

arabic text:
Tum Naade Ali parte jali khaak pe sojaana
Sakina, ghabraaon nahi hum aayenge khwaabon mei
english translation text:
Recite Nad-e-Ali, then sleep upon the burning earth,
Sakina, do not be afraid—we shall come to you in your dreams.

arabic text:
Suno Baba Ali mushkil kusha ab toh chale aao
Sadaa deti hei Zainab berida Shaam e ghareebaan mei
english translation text:
Listen, O father Ali, remover of hardships, now come to our aid,
Thus cries Zainab, unveiled, in the desolation of Shaam-e-Ghareeban.

arabic text:
Mohammed ka gharaana, Karbala waale bayaan baa mei
Qayaamat ki khiza, Aayi hai Zahra ke gulistaan mei
english translation text:
The Household of Muhammad lies upon the plains of Karbala,
The season of calamity has descended upon every garden of Zahra.
